about: IXL skills per Savvas lesson, authored by IXL shortcut code (data/ixl-algebra2-skills.json resolves code -> name, directory id, link). `prereq` skills come first and are what a Group Jam warms up on; `core` skills are the lesson itself. A literal { name, url, level } entry is allowed for a skill outside the Algebra 2 map. Resolved by scripts/build-a2-lesson-skills.mjs into content/a2/lesson-skills.json (every lesson, for the calendar) and content/a2/lessons.json supportingSkills (published lessons). Topics 1-2 mapped 2026-09-17 from the lesson objectives in the Topic 2 docs and the Savvas lesson titles. Each entry may carry `example` (an example number or list of numbers from the Savvas lesson) so the Desk can name the IXL skill to Web Jam when that example is going badly; skills without `example` are lesson-wide.
